meta.title: Approved purchase intake automatically generates a Purchase Request
gaps: Submit the purchase intake request and have its approver(s) approve it.
Verify that the observed Purchase Request was automatically generated from the approved intake rather than being an unrelated existing request.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Submit the purchase intake request and have its approver(s) approve it.; Verify that the observed Purchase Request was automatically generated from the approved intake rather than being an unrelated existing request.

args.need: submit the purchase intake request and have its approver(s) approve it, then return to the buyer console

steps.note: No catalog step can submit a purchase intake or perform its approval workflow.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area after the tester completes the intake approval.
Show open Purchase Requests, where an approved intake-generated request should be available.
Check that at least one Purchase Request row exists, though the catalog cannot establish that it came from the approved intake.
